# Puter Developer

> > Comprehensive developer documentation for Puter.js AI integration, featuring API references for GPT-5, Qwen, Liquid AI, and dozens of other language models.

Puter Developer provides JavaScript and Node.js developers with unified access to leading AI models through the Puter.js library. The platform supports user-pays billing and seamless integration with React, Vue, and other frameworks for building AI-powered applications.

## Key Topics

- Puter.js
- AI API Integration
- Chat Models
- Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)
- User-Pays Model
- Agentic Coding
- OpenAI GPT-5
- Qwen Models
- Liquid AI
- JavaScript/Node.js SDK
- Vision-Language Models
- On-Device AI
- Chat API
- Developer API
- Puter AI API

## Premier AI Models

- [GPT-5 Chat API](https://developer.puter.com/ai/openai/gpt-5-chat): OpenAI GPT-5 Chat conversational API reference for ChatGPT model
- [GPT-4 Turbo API](https://developer.puter.com/ai/openai/gpt-4-turbo): OpenAI GPT-4 Turbo API reference with 128K context and pricing info
- [Cohere API](https://developer.puter.com/ai/cohere): Cohere API integration via Puter.js for Command A and R7B models
- [Morph API](https://developer.puter.com/ai/morph): Morph API integration for V3 Fast and Large code editing models

## Qwen Model Family

- [Qwen3 VL 235B A22B Instruct API](https://developer.puter.com/ai/qwen/qwen3-vl-235b-a22b-instruct): Qwen3 VL 235B vision-language MoE model with 256K context API
- [Qwen3 Next 80B A3B Thinking API](https://developer.puter.com/ai/qwen/qwen3-next-80b-a3b-thinking): Qwen3 Next 80B reasoning-enhanced model API with hybrid attention
- [Qwen3 8B API](https://developer.puter.com/ai/qwen/qwen3-8b): Qwen3 8B dense model API with hybrid thinking modes and 128K context

## Specialized Coding Models

- [xAI: Grok Code Fast 1 API](https://developer.puter.com/ai/x-ai/grok-code-fast-1): xAI Grok Code Fast 1 API reference for agentic coding workflows
- [Kwaipilot: KAT-Coder-Pro V1 API](https://developer.puter.com/ai/kwaipilot/kat-coder-pro): Kwaipilot KAT-Coder-Pro V1 agentic coding model API documentation

## Liquid AI & On-Device Models

- [LFM2-24B-A2B API](https://developer.puter.com/ai/liquid/lfm-2-24b-a2b): Liquid AI LFM2-24B-A2B hybrid MoE model API with 2.3B active params
- [LFM2-8B-A1B API](https://developer.puter.com/ai/liquid/lfm2-8b-a1b): Liquid AI LFM2-8B-A1B Mixture-of-Experts on-device model API

## Additional Model Providers

- [Gemma 3 4B API](https://developer.puter.com/ai/google/gemma-3-4b-it): Google Gemma 3 4B Instruct multimodal API with 128K context window
- [TNG: DeepSeek R1T2 Chimera API](https://developer.puter.com/ai/tngtech/deepseek-r1t2-chimera): TNG Tech DeepSeek R1T2 Chimera 671B tri-parent model API reference
- [Tencent: Hunyuan A13B Instruct API](https://developer.puter.com/ai/tencent/hunyuan-a13b-instruct): Tencent Hunyuan A13B Mixture-of-Experts model API documentation
